capabilities: Create a Business Model Canvas .canvas file from the command palette or ribbon
Prompt for a business or project name used in the file name
Arrange nine text cards in the classic BMC grid with non-overlapping coordinates
Color-code cards with Canvas color IDs and emoji headings with prompting questions
Open the generated canvas automatically after creation
disambiguation: Despite the name suggesting a broader strategy toolkit, it only generates Business Model Canvas layouts.
extras: Manual installation only: users must build the plugin with npm and copy main.js and manifest.json into the vault. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian Canvas starts blank, so building a structured framework like the Business Model Canvas means manually placing and styling nine cards every time.
summary: One-click generator that creates a color-coded Business Model Canvas as an Obsidian Canvas file via command palette or ribbon button.
